feature_contract.goal: Translate genuine live D3D9 SM3 DEFI/REP/ENDREP shader repetition with nested conditional control to guarded native DX11 VS/PS for menu-to-race Draw/DrawIndexed and full-frame publication while preserving original D3D9 input and fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Real game shader DEFI/REP/ENDREP materializes into bounded HLSL loop inside VS/PS and existing full-frame native D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed path.
Reject live i registers without DEFI, zero/oversize counts, mixed IF/REP nesting and malformed operands; branch definite-write state and original D3D9 gamepad path remain safe.
Portable C++ regression, integrated source check, exact-SHA Fast, Backend, Win32, OpenXR and HUD Gates all pass before build verified acceptance.

integration_path: Intercept game D3D9 SM3 bytecode from Draw and DrawIndexed
Parse shader-owned DEFI literal and REP/ENDREP plus IF/ELSE/ENDIF nesting with bounded repeat and definite writes
Emit HLSL bounded loops into VS/PS and native full-frame Draw path with original D3D9 input fallback
Require exact-SHA five GitHub gates, then obtain separate actual-game/Quest3 evidence

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Portable nested conditional/repeat C++ and real parser-to-HLSL source integration tests
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Dynamic i#, missing DEFI, malformed operands, zero/oversized nested repeat, invalid crossing flow, uninitialized temp/output fail closed
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Captured D3D9 VS/PS -> shader-owned DEFI/REP -> native HLSL shader -> existing native full-resolution Draw/DrawIndexed

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native opt-in remains fail closed; source-game dynamic integer state never guessed; D3D9Ex game rendering/input/FFB/SkyGlow untouched, DXVK frozen.
